verses.en: And the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
verses.pt: E apareceu-lhe o SENHOR nos carvalhos de Manre, estando ele sentado à porta de sua tenda no calor do dia.
verses.en_web: Yahweh appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.
verses.en_bbe: Now the Lord came to him by the holy tree of Mamre, when he was seated in the doorway of his tent in the middle of the day;

verses.en: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,
verses.pt: E levantou seus olhos e olhou, e eis que três homens que estavam junto a ele: e quando os viu, saiu correndo da porta de sua tenda a recebê-los, e inclinou-se até a terra,
verses.en_web: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood opposite him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,
verses.en_bbe: And lifting up his eyes, he saw three men before him; and seeing them, he went quickly to them from the door of the tent, and went down on his face to the earth;

verses.en: And said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:
verses.pt: E disse: Senhor, se agora achei favor aos teus olhos, rogo-te que não passes de teu servo.
verses.en_web: and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.
verses.en_bbe: And said, My Lord, if now I have grace in your eyes, do not go away from your servant:

verses.en: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:
verses.pt: Que se traga agora um pouco de água, e lavai vossos pés; e recostai-vos debaixo de uma árvore,
verses.en_web: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.
verses.en_bbe: Let me get water for washing your feet, and take your rest under the tree:

verses.en: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.
verses.pt: E trarei um bocado de pão, e confortai vosso coração; depois passareis; pois por isso passastes perto de vosso servo.
verses.en_web: I will get a morsel of bread so you can refresh your heart. After that you may go your way, now that you have come to your servant.” They said, “Very well, do as you have said.”
verses.en_bbe: And let me get a bit of bread to keep up your strength, and after that you may go on your way: for this is why you have come to your servant. And they said, Let it be so.

verses.en: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.
verses.pt: Então Abraão foi depressa à tenda a Sara, e lhe disse: Toma logo três medidas de boa farinha, amassa e faz pães cozidos.
verses.en_web: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Abraham went quickly into the tent, and said to Sarah, Get three measures of meal straight away and make cakes.

verses.en: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.
verses.pt: E correu Abraão às vacas, e tomou um bezerro tenro e bom, e deu-o ao jovem, e deu-se este pressa a prepará-lo.
verses.en_web: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.
verses.en_bbe: And running to the herd, he took a young ox, soft and fat, and gave it to the servant and he quickly made it ready;

verses.en: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.
verses.pt: Tomou também manteiga e leite, e o bezerro que havia preparado, e o pôs diante deles; e ele estava junto a eles debaixo da árvore; e comeram.
verses.en_web: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.
verses.en_bbe: And he took butter and milk and the young ox which he had made ready and put it before them, waiting by them under the tree while they took food.

verses.en: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
verses.pt: E lhe disseram: Onde está Sara tua mulher? E ele respondeu: Aqui na tenda.
verses.en_web: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He said, “See, in the tent.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said to him, Where is Sarah your wife? And he said, She is in the tent.

verses.en: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.
verses.pt: Então disse: De certo voltarei a ti segundo o tempo da vida, e eis que Sara, tua mulher, terá um filho.
verses.en_web: He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, I will certainly come back to you in the spring, and Sarah your wife will have a son. And his words came to the ears of Sarah who was at the back of the tent-door.

verses.en: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.
verses.pt: Abraão e Sara eram idosos, avançados em dias; a Sara já havia cessado o costume das mulheres.
verses.en_web: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.
verses.en_bbe: Now Abraham and Sarah were very old, and Sarah was past the time for giving birth.

verses.en: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
verses.pt: Riu, pois, Sara consigo mesma, dizendo: Depois que envelheci terei prazer, sendo também meu senhor já velho?
verses.en_web: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”
verses.en_bbe: And Sarah, laughing to herself, said, Now that I am used up am I still to have pleasure, my husband himself being old?

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?
verses.pt: Então o SENHOR disse a Abraão: Por que Sara riu dizendo: Será verdade que darei à luz, sendo já velha?
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child, yet I am old?’
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said, Why was Sarah laughing and saying, Is it possible for me, being old, to give birth to a child?

verses.en: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
verses.pt: Há para Deus alguma coisa difícil? Ao tempo assinalado voltarei a ti, segundo o tempo da vida, e Sara terá um filho.
verses.en_web: Is anything too hard for Yahweh? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes round, and Sarah will have a son.”
verses.en_bbe: Is there any wonder which the Lord is not able to do? At the time I said, in the spring, I will come back to you, and Sarah will have a child.

verses.en: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.
verses.pt: Então Sara negou dizendo: Não ri; pois teve medo. Mas ele disse: Não é assim, mas riste.
verses.en_web: Then Sarah denied it, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid. He said, “No, but you did laugh.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Sarah said, I was not laughing; for she was full of fear. And he said, No, but you were laughing.

verses.en: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.
verses.pt: E os homens se levantaram dali, e olharam até Sodoma: e Abraão ia com eles acompanhando-os.
verses.en_web: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.
verses.en_bbe: And the men went on from there in the direction of Sodom; and Abraham went with them on their way.

verses.en: And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;
verses.pt: E o SENHOR disse: Encobrirei eu a Abraão o que vou a fazer,
verses.en_web: Yahweh said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said, Am I to keep back from Abraham the knowledge of what I do;

verses.en: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
verses.pt: Havendo de ser Abraão em uma nação grande e forte, e havendo de ser benditas nele todas as nações da terra?
verses.en_web: since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?
verses.en_bbe: Seeing that Abraham will certainly become a great and strong nation, and his name will be used by all the nations of the earth as a blessing?

verses.en: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the LORD, to do justice and judgment; that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.
verses.pt: Porque eu o conheci, sei que mandará a seus filhos e a sua casa depois de si, que guardem o caminho do SENHOR, fazendo justiça e juízo, para que faça vir o SENHOR sobre Abraão o que falou acerca dele.
verses.en_web: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of Yahweh, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that Yahweh may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”
verses.en_bbe: For I have made him mine so that he may give orders to his children and those of his line after him, to keep the ways of the Lord, to do what is good and right: so that the Lord may do to Abraham as he has said.

verses.en: And the LORD said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;
verses.pt: Então o SENHOR lhe disse: Porquanto o clamor de Sodoma e Gomorra se aumenta mais e mais, e o pecado deles se agravou em extremo,
verses.en_web: Yahweh said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said, Because the outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is very great, and their sin is very evil,

verses.en: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.
verses.pt: Descerei agora, e verei se consumaram sua obra segundo o clamor que veio até mim; e se não, eu o saberei.
verses.en_web: I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”
verses.en_bbe: I will go down now, and see if their acts are as bad as they seem from the outcry which has come to me; and if they are not, I will see.

verses.en: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.
verses.pt: E apartaram-se dali os homens, e foram até Sodoma: mas Abraão estava ainda diante do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And the men, turning from that place, went on to Sodom: but Abraham was still waiting before the Lord.

verses.en: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?
verses.pt: E aproximou-se Abraão e disse: Destruirás também ao justo com o ímpio?
verses.en_web: Abraham came near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?
verses.en_bbe: And Abraham came near, and said, Will you let destruction come on the upright with the sinners?

verses.en: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?
verses.pt: Talvez haja cinquenta justos dentro da cidade: destruirás também e não perdoarás ao lugar por cinquenta justos que estejam dentro dela?
verses.en_web: What if there are fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it?
verses.en_bbe: If by chance there are fifty upright men in the town, will you give the place to destruction and not have mercy on it because of the fifty upright men?

verses.en: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
verses.pt: Longe de ti o fazer tal, que faças morrer ao justo com o ímpio e que seja o justo tratado como o ímpio; nunca faças tal. O juiz de toda a terra, não há de fazer o que é justo?
verses.en_web: Be it far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”
verses.en_bbe: Let such a thing be far from you, to put the upright to death with the sinner: will not the judge of all the earth do right?

verses.en: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.
verses.pt: Então respondeu o SENHOR: Se achar em Sodoma cinquenta justos dentro da cidade, perdoarei a todo este lugar por causa deles.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said, If there are fifty upright men in the town, I will have mercy on it because of them.

verses.en: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which am but dust and ashes:
verses.pt: E Abraão replicou e disse: Eis que agora que comecei a falar a meu Senhor, ainda que sou pó e cinza:
verses.en_web: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.
verses.en_bbe: And Abraham answering said, Truly, I who am only dust, have undertaken to put my thoughts before the Lord:

verses.en: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.
verses.pt: Talvez faltem de cinquenta justos cinco; destruirás por aqueles cinco toda a cidade? E disse: Não a destruirei, se achar ali quarenta e cinco.
verses.en_web: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He said, “I will not destroy it if I find forty-five there.”
verses.en_bbe: If by chance there are five less than fifty upright men, will you give up all the town to destruction because of these five? And he said, I will not give it to destruction if there are forty-five.

verses.en: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for forty’s sake.
verses.pt: E voltou a falar-lhe, e disse: Talvez se acharão ali quarenta. E respondeu: Não o farei por causa dos quarenta.
verses.en_web: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s sake.”
verses.en_bbe: And again he said to him, By chance there may be forty there. And he said, I will not do it if there are forty.

verses.en: And he said unto him, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.
verses.pt: E disse: Não se ire agora meu Senhor, se falar: talvez se achem ali trinta. E respondeu: Não o farei se achar ali trinta.
verses.en_web: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?” He said, “I will not do it if I find thirty there.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Let not the Lord be angry with me if I say, What if there are thirty there? And he said, I will not do it if there are thirty.

verses.en: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty’s sake.
verses.pt: E disse: Eis que agora que me empreendi em falar a meu Senhor: talvez se achem ali vinte. Não a destruirei, respondeu, por causa dos vinte.
verses.en_web: He said, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, See now, I have undertaken to put my thoughts before the Lord: what if there are twenty there? And he said, I will have mercy because of the twenty.

verses.en: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for ten’s sake.
verses.pt: E voltou a dizer: Não se ire agora meu Senhor, se falar somente uma vez: talvez se achem ali dez. Não a destruirei, respondeu, por causa dos dez.
verses.en_web: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the ten’s sake.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, O let not the Lord be angry and I will say only one word more: by chance there may be ten there. And he said, I will have mercy because of the ten.

verses.en: And the LORD went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
verses.pt: E foi-se o SENHOR, logo que acabou de falar a Abraão: e Abraão se voltou a seu lugar.
verses.en_web: Yahweh went his way, as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord went on his way when his talk with Abraham was ended, and Abraham went back to his place.
